title: General
text: The purpose of this procedure is to perform access barring check for an access attempt associated with a given Access Category and one or more Access Identities upon request from upper layers according to TS 24.501 or the RRC layer. This procedure does not apply to IAB-MT. This procedure does not apply to L2 U2N Relay UE initiating RRC connection establishment or RRC connection resume upon reception of any message from a L2 U2N remote UE via SL- RLC0 or SL-RLC1 in accordance to 5.3.3.1a and 5.3.13.1a.
After a PCell change in RRC_CONNECTED   the UE shall defer access barring checks until it has obtained SIB1 (as specified in 5.2.2.2) from the target cell.
